page.layout: One page of running text in a single column, with a running head at the top and a signature and catchword at the foot. No marginal notes.

main_text.p: vel jurati verum dicere renuunt, aut am-biguis responsis interrogantem eludunt. Huius doctrinæ turpitudinem tam dextrè retegit, & quæ ab adversariis pro mendaciis & æquivocationibus diabolicis dicuntur, tam fortiter convellit Reverendissimus Abbattus: ut fieri non posse statuam, quin, qui hæc diligenter pellegerit, totam Æquivocorum cohortem, perinde ac ipsum Erebi principem sit execraturus.

Jam quod crimen atrocius Ecclesiis Re-formatis infertur hodie, quàm quod DEUM iniquitatis non dico patronum, sed autorem ipsum facere dicuntur? At clarissimus ABBATTUS ita hoc diluit: ut una eademque opera & maledicorum accusatorum ora comprimat, & Ecclesiarum magnæ Britanniæ cum Gallicis, Germanicis, aliisque reformatis consensum luculenter commonstret.
Mihi quidem vel eo nomine iterata huius libelli lectio perquam fuit grata, quod memoriam mihi renovaret beatæ illius hiemis, quam secutus Serenissimum Principe meum,

page.notes: The scan shows the title as "DEDICATORIA" with a trailing mark, read here as the running head. The word "Principe" at the end of the last line is read as printed but is slightly unclear at the line end. Faint show-through text from the reverse side is ignored. The signature reads "* 3" (the 3 may resemble ȝ). Long s rendered as plain s. The printed "statuam" was copied as "statuam".
